execution: Stop-loss 3,776.86: below the daily OB with a 0.25 ATR buffer (459.24 points, 10.8%). Place it as a GTT/SL order right away.
Size from the stop: quantity = risk in rupees / stop distance. Never widen the stop to fit a bigger size.
trail: At T1 (+1R): book part, keep the original stop. No early breakeven.
At T2 (+2R): protect behind the new daily higher low.
Then trail by daily structure (below each new higher low), never by a fixed amount.
Exit before the results date if it falls inside the hold.
If the daily closes back below the zone, exit: the structure has failed.
